## Built for speed

Quadratic Lite removes the boilerplate so your team can focus on content and experience — not infrastructure.

- **Mock-first** — build and test offline without a live hub
- **Token-driven** — swap brands by redefining CSS variables
- **Composable** — atoms, molecules, and organisms stack cleanly

Ready to ship? Clone the repo, point it at your Amplience hub, and go.
